messages:
Sam (docs): FYI — the docs preview CI is failing on a couple of PRs and it's blocking the review queue. Can someone pick up manual checks? :grimacing:
Priya (eng): which PRs? link?
Sam (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 and /pull/439. Both show the same validation error in the preview job.
docs-preview-bot: Preview build failed for PR #432 — HTML validator error: broken link: /api/v1/old-endpoint -> 404
Rachel (rotation): I'm currently on-call for reviews but tied up with triage until 11:30. I can do a quick sweep after that.
Marco (docs-lead): If someone can do a manual link-check and post the exact failing href, we can fast-follow with a quick patch. We should also reroute the next 2 PRs in the queue to Ethan if needed.
Ethan (devex): I can pick up one of them now (have a small gap). Which one is higher priority?
Sam (docs): #432 is gating the migration guide merge — higher priority. #439 is a minor snippet fix.
Priya (eng): Quick idea — assign an alternate reviewer label `docs/urgent-preview` and let the rota skip people already in review backlogs. Could we do that temporarily?
Marco (docs-lead): Good call. Sam, can you add that label and ping @here? Keep it timeboxed to today.
Sam (docs): Done — label added and pinged. Also pasted the failing href in the PR comment: `/v1/models/old-model -> /v1/models`
Ethan (devex): Found the broken link in #432, sending a patch in a sec. Running `make docs-check` locally flagged the same issue.
Rachel (rotation): If Ethan fixes #432 I can approve and merge after CI passes. I'll also take #439 after 11:30 if still needed.
Ethan (devex): Patch opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/440 — replaces the old endpoint link and adds a short note in the migration guide.
docs-preview-bot: Preview build started for PR #440
Sam (docs): Thanks — I'll watch the preview. Also let's add a tiny checklist to the PR template to run `make docs-check` locally to reduce these.
Marco (docs-lead): Agree. Can you open a follow-up PR to the template? Low priority but useful.
Priya (eng): After merge, can we add a short blurb to the internal docs channel about the label/rota fallback so the on-call folks know the temporary process?
Sam (docs): Will do. Thanks everyone! :tada:
